title: Jangle
summary: JAN'GLE, verb intransitive To quarrel in words; to altercate; to bicker; to wrangle. JAN'GLE, verb transitive To cause to sound untunably or discordantly. --E'er monkish rhymes Had jangl'd their fanta

inlines.v: JAN'GLE, verb intransitive To quarrel in words; to altercate; to bicker; to wrangle. JAN'GLE, verb transitive To cause to sound untunably or discordantly. --E'er monkish rhymes Had jangl'd their fantastic chimes.
